Status: Wave 265 accepted (6.3): the last namable ObjectModel rows

Method.evidence: Every row read from its own IL through NameCandidates --inspect-methods. The last namable ObjectModel rows in one wave: the persistent root predicate, the collection-changed listener registration, the usage store factory, the empty-channel collector, the two project tag predicates, the icon-data update forwarder, three validator lists (AddProjectTrace, DeleteProjectTrace, RenameChannelInstance), the ChangeProjectGuid path predicate closure, the CSV separator scan, the extended-copy project header, the backup directory move, the addin data store lookup, the mask version medium-type match, the synchronous action invoker and the big-endian byte conversion.
Method.themes: The validator lists follow the earlier CreateValidators convention. Byte-identical duplicates stay unnamed: ChangeGroupAddressStyleOperation::c equals the already-named CreateToFreeConverter (0x06003447) and CombineMainElementsPatcher::a(XmlNode) equals the already-named FindSegmentNumberNodes (0x06004B2A), both compared instruction by instruction. Still unresolved after this wave: MoveGroupAddressStrategy::a(UInt16) (the step field b semantics are not established), ArchiveProjectVersionExtensions::b(string,int) (an uncalled XOR-and-intern transform), ImportGroupAddressesOperation::a(RangeMapping,GroupRangeImportValue) (empty body), ArgumentHandler::a() (only sets a flag), ProjectTrace::a(string) (routes through the unreviewed arc helper), the five Devices predicates, the two Pin interface implementations and the DotfuscatorAttribute accessors.
